name: ライブ記事の要点と関連リンク
prompt:
Create one landscape editorial summary-and-related-link panel. Use the supplied Guardian source crop for the 1125x406 landscape bounds and content hierarchy, and the localized native preview for Lighthouse colors, typography, and Japanese wording. Use a flat solid dark green background exactly like the preview (#065F46). Place these exact two summary lines near the upper left in readable white Meiryo-style Japanese sans-serif:
現地から届いた最新情報をもとに、
今日の動きをわかりやすくまとめます。
Below the summary, add a small white circular bullet and the exact related-link label 「これまでの経緯を知る」 in white, left-aligned with the text start matching the native preview. Finish with the thin pale mint divider shown in the preview near the bottom edge. Keep generous but balanced space between the summary and the link. No English copy, extra text, photos, gradients, texture, borders, or additional icons. Produce a single flat component image.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
